name: VMUtils
title: VMUtils - Global
summary: The VMUtils script include provides methods for discovery and provisioning of virtual machines.
overview: This script include is available in server-side scripts to convert between UUID and Correlation ID formats.

members.name: turnCorrelationIdToUuid
members.summary: Converts a correlation ID into a UUID for a virtual machine in the ServiceNow system.
members.html:
Parameters
Name Type Description
correlationId String The correlation ID to convert
Returns
Type Description
String The UUID, or an empty string if invalid. 
gs.info(VMUtils.turnCorrelationIdToUuid('42 10 82 82 62 35 ca 68-b5 1c 1e f8 5c 0a 0d 5b'));

Output:

42108282-6235-ca68-b51c-1ef85c0a0d5b

members.name: turnUuidToCorrelationId
members.summary: Converts a WMware universal unique identifier (UUID) to a format that matches the original format in the ServiceNow system.
members.html:
vCenter works with UUIDs where the ESXi Linux console worked with this format.

Parameters
Name Type Description
uuid String The UUID to convert.
Returns
Type Description
String The identifier converted to the ServiceNow format. 
gs.info(VMUtils.turnUuidToCorrelationId('13eb78d0-d504-11e1-9b23-0800200c9a66'));

Output:

13 eb 78 d0 d5 04 11 e1-9b 23 08 00 20 0c 9a 66
